description: Schedule 1 line 8 other income feeds AGI and the SS 86 worksheet: MFJ, $20,000 wages + $30,000 gambling winnings (W-2G) + $20,000 social security. Provisional income = 50,000 + 10,000 (half SS) = 60,000 > $44,000 -> 85% tier: min(0.85 x 20,000 = 17,000; 0.85 x 16,000 + 6,000 = 19,600) = $17,000 taxable SS. AGI = 20,000 + 30,000 + 17,000 = $67,000. Hand-computed.
